product_one_liner.value: Upstage provides enterprise AI—Solar large language models and document-processing products such as Document Parse and Information Extract—to help businesses automate document-heavy workflows in insurance, healthcare, financial services, and manufacturing.

pricing_page.notes: The page lists API/model and commitment-tier pricing.

employee_band.notes: The available company profile reports 260 employees and the 201–500 band.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes multiple technical/model-building posts, including Solar architecture and AWS SageMaker training and deployment.

public_docs.notes: The public console documentation includes API, model, document-AI, agent, and integration articles.

model_provider.value: Solar, Upstage’s proprietary large-language-model family; AWS is its preferred cloud provider for building and deploying the models.
